name: app-black-results-page-with-giant-thin-percentages-and-athlete-photo
title: Black 'Result & Impact' page with three staggered giant thin percentages and a rounded athlete photo
whatItIs: A near-black page with a header of small corner labels and a white logo mark, a large two-tone title 'Result & Impact', a paragraph with dimmed phrases, three huge thin percentages (99%, 89%, 94%) on vertical hairlines stepping down and right, and a rounded photo of a running athlete on a peach backdrop with a red hotspot on the thigh at the left.
whatItMeans: Clear and energetic; staggered giant numerals steer the eye while the peach photo adds warmth to black.
techniques: Step giant thin numerals diagonally with hairlines.
Use a single warm photo on a dark page.
Add a small hotspot on the photo.
bestFor: Fitness and AI coaching case studies

vocabulary.definition: Big figures offset in a diagonal.
A thin vertical line beside a stat.
A glowing spot on a photo showing data.
A title with the second line dimmed.
